messages:
helen: Heads-up: deploy-bot queued UNPIN runtime v2.20 -> v2.21 for canary at 07:00 UTC. Flagging runtime/QA/sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN runtime v2.20 -> v2.21 (canary). Trigger: nightly-release-window. ETA: 07:00 UTC.
chris: Quick note from QA smoke: v2.21 changes kernel aliasing for sparse attention. We saw a mismatch on a subset of models where the runtime falls back to legacy kernel causing slight output drift.
qa-jay: Repro steps: `./tests/smoke --profile sparse --model gptx-small --runtime v2.21` -> diff in first token probabilities.
qa-jay: Diff snippet:
```
expected: "The"
actual:   "A"
KL divergence: 0.08
```
runtime-syl: That drift is likely due to a change in kernel prioritization. I can reproduce locally and a local revert restores probabilities.
sre-maria: Impact: telemetry shows ~0.05% of production calls use the sparse path for gptx-small; mostly internal dev apps but could affect experiments.
pm-ana: Product: if drift is subtle it's still a regression for eval baselines. Recommend holding canary until we triage.
helen: Decision: PAUSE unpin for canary. Runtime team to triage kernel selection policy and propose either alias mapping or conservatively preserve old fallback.
runtime-syl: I'll open a hotfix PR with alias mapping and add a targeted smoke test for probability diffs. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2022 "fix: preserve sparse kernel alias priority for gptx family"
qa-jay: CI ETA ~30m. If green we can run a 5% canary restricted to sparse-profile models.
sre-maria: I'll add an alert to watch KL divergence on sparse path > 0.02 as a guard.
chris: If fix lands and canary is clean for 30m, resume unpin. If not, rollback runtime PR and keep previous pin.
deploy-bot: PAUSE confirmed: UNPIN action paused for thread 2601234567. Waiting on manual resume.
qa-jay: CI green (2601236200). Artifact ready: runtime:v2.21-hotfix-2022.
helen: Starting scoped canary at 07:45 UTC to 5% canary fleet (sparse-profile only).
qa-jay: Observing: KL divergence within threshold, no latency impact.
pm-ana: Fine to proceed with full canary then rollout. I'll update release notes with a note about kernel alias change and the compatibility guard.
helen: Resume UNPIN at 08:30 UTC per rollout plan. deploy-bot please proceed.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN: staged canary -> remaining canary -> regional rollouts.
sre-maria: Monitoring live, alert thresholds in place.
helen: Closing thread, thanks all for the quick triage. :white_check_mark:
